task: Design and evaluate KA-GNNs for molecular property prediction
named_methods: Graph Neural Network (GNN) - specifically GCN-style message passing
KA-GNN: GNN with KAN layers replacing MLPs

molecular_representation.nodes: atoms with features (type, degree, charge, hybridization, aromaticity)
molecular_representation.edges: bonds with features (type, conjugation, ring, stereo) + non-covalent interactions

key_claims_to_test: KA-GNN improves predictive accuracy over MLP-based GNN
KA-GNN enhances interpretability via Fourier decomposition
